headline: Falkland Islands Host Royal Visit Ahead of ITLOS Sea Lion Oil Dispute Hearings
summary: Princess Anne visited the Falkland Islands ahead of International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea hearings in Hamburg regarding Argentina's legal challenge against the Sea Lion offshore oil project.
why: The Sea Lion oilfield project holds major commercial crude reserves; international tribunal rulings impact regional offshore energy concessions.

impacts.name: Falkland Islands
impacts.why: Pending ITLOS hearings determine legal jurisdiction risks surrounding offshore hydrocarbon extraction.
